batch: dynamic (N >= 1, one t for the whole batch)

frames: RGB canvas, channel first (fill 832x480; see policy.py)

latent: normalized Wan2.2 latent of the current frame

x_vision: latent video state; frame 0 = conditioning latent
x_action: action state; first 9 channels are the av action
t: model-space timestep = meta.model_t[step], shared by the batch

v_vision: flow velocity (zero on the conditioning frame)
v_action: flow velocity (zero beyond the raw channels)

sampler: UniPC order 2 (bh2, x0-prediction), default 20 steps: coefficients in meta.json 'unipc'/'model_t'; other counts in 'schedules'
actions: per-step camera pose T_i^-1 T_(i+1): [t_xyz (x right, y down, z fwd; model metres) | first two rotation columns], 10 Hz, unnormalized
